title: The janazah du‘a
intro: The du‘a we recite for the deceased after the third takbir of the janazah prayer.

learn.html: The janazah du‘a is a Sunnah of the Prophet Muhammad (SAW). It is recited after the third takbir during the janazah prayer. In it we ask Allah (SWT) to forgive all of us – the living and the dead – and to have mercy on the person who has died.

learn.text: The du‘a for an adult (man or woman)

learn.label: For all of us
learn.ar: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِحَيِّنَا وَمَيِّتِنَا وَشَاهِدِنَا وَغَائِبِنَا وَكَبِيرِنَا وَصَغِيرِنَا وَذَكَرِنَا وَأُنْثَانَا
learn.tr: Allaahummaghfir li hayyinaa wa mayyitinaa, wa shaahidinaa wa ghaa’ibinaa, wa kabeerinaa wa sagheerinaa, wa dhakarinaa wa unthaanaa.
learn.en: O Allah, forgive our living and our dead, those of us who are present and those who are absent, our old and our young, our men and our women.

learn.label: Living on Islam, dying with iman
learn.ar: اللَّهُمَّ مَنْ أَحْيَيْتَهُ مِنَّا فَأَحْيِهِ عَلَى الْإِسْلَامِ، وَمَنْ تَوَفَّيْتَهُ مِنَّا فَتَوَفَّهُ عَلَى الْإِيمَانِ
learn.tr: Allaahumma man ahyaytahoo minnaa fa-ahyihee ‘alal-islaam, wa man tawaffaytahoo minnaa fa-tawaffahoo ‘alal-eemaan.
learn.en: O Allah, whoever of us You keep alive, keep him alive on Islam, and whoever of us You take, take him with iman.

learn.label: For the deceased
learn.ar: وَخُصَّ هَذَا الْمَيِّتَ بِالرَّوْحِ وَالرَّاحَةِ وَالرَّحْمَةِ وَالْمَغْفِرَةِ وَالرِّضْوَانِ
learn.tr: Wa khussa haadhal-mayyita bir-rawhi war-raahati war-rahmati wal-maghfirati war-ridwaan.
learn.en: And grant this deceased person comfort, rest, mercy, forgiveness and Your pleasure.

learn.label: Good deeds and mistakes
learn.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنْ كَانَ مُحْسِنًا فَزِدْ فِي إِحْسَانِهِ، وَإِنْ كَانَ مُسِيئًا فَتَجَاوَزْ عَنْهُ، وَلَقِّهِ الْأَمْنَ وَالْبُشْرَى وَالْكَرَامَةَ وَالزُّلْفَى، بِرَحْمَتِكَ يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينَ
learn.tr: Allaahumma in kaana muhsinan fa-zid fee ihsaanihee, wa in kaana musee’an fa-tajaawaz ‘anhu, wa laqqihil-amna wal-bushraa wal-karaamata waz-zulfaa, bi-rahmatika yaa arhamar-raahimeen.
learn.en: O Allah, if he did good, add to his good; and if he did wrong, overlook it. Give him safety, good news, honour and nearness to You, by Your mercy, O Most Merciful of the merciful.

learn.title: For a woman
learn.html: When the deceased is a woman, some words change: haadhihil-mayyitata (this deceased woman), in kaanat muhsinatan, fee ihsaanihaa, in kaanat musee’atan, ‘anhaa and laqqihaa. Your muallim will help you with them.

learn.text: The du‘a for a child (boy or girl)

learn.html: For a child who has died, we begin with the same first part (Allaahummaghfir li hayyinaa… up to …‘alal-eemaan), and then say:

learn.label: For a child
learn.ar: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْهُ لَنَا فَرَطًا، اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْهُ لَنَا أَجْرًا وَذُخْرًا، اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْهُ لَنَا شَافِعًا وَمُشَفَّعًا، يَشْفَعُ لَنَا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ، بِرَحْمَتِكَ يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينَ
learn.tr: Allaahummaj‘alhu lanaa faratan. Allaahummaj‘alhu lanaa ajran wa dhukhraa. Allaahummaj‘alhu lanaa shaafi‘an wa mushaffa‘an, yashfa‘u lanaa yawmal-qiyaamah, bi-rahmatika yaa arhamar-raahimeen.
learn.en: O Allah, make him one who goes ahead of us (to prepare for us). O Allah, make him a reward and a treasure for us. O Allah, make him one who intercedes for us and whose intercession is accepted on the Day of Judgement, by Your mercy, O Most Merciful of the merciful.

learn.title: For a girl
learn.html: For a girl we say Allaahummaj‘alhaa instead of Allaahummaj‘alhu, shaafi‘atan wa mushaffa‘atan and tashfa‘u.

learn.title: ⭐ Remember
learn.html: The janazah du‘a is recited quietly, after the third takbir. In it we pray for all Muslims – which teaches us that we are one family.

questions.q: When is the janazah du‘a recited?
Who do we ask forgiveness for at the start of the du‘a?
options: All of us – living and dead, young and old

questions.q: In the du‘a for a child, what do we ask that the child be for us?
options: A reward, a treasure and an intercessor

questions.q: What word changes for a girl in “Allaahummaj‘alhu”?

practice.title: Practise with your muallim
prompts: 🎧 Listen to the janazah du‘a (scan the QR code in your book) and practise reciting it with your muallim, part by part.
🤲 Why do you think we pray for all Muslims – the living and the dead – and not only for the person who died?
